Image Description: The image depicts a modern, well-lit living room with a minimalist design. The room features a large black leather sectional sofa arranged in an L-shape, positioned on a light green area rug that contrasts with the warm-toned wooden flooring. In front of the sofa is a matching black leather ottoman serving as a coffee table, which holds a small decorative bowl. 

The walls are painted white, and the ceiling is dark gray or black, creating a contrast with the lighter elements
